title: A stone cliff on the railroad
text: Cantil is Spanish for stone cliff, and it was one of a series of C names chosen for this stretch of railroad, along with Cambio, Cinco, and Ceneda. It was founded as a station on the Nevada and California Railroad in 1908 or 1909, when the line was extended from Owens Lake to Mojave. The first post office opened in 1916.
